author: CC
prose: Measured 2026-09-07: `python3 -m cairn.machines.skill_block fire idea <packet>` printed a berth (idea-20260907T151134-98353e782433.json) and wrote nothing under CairnCommons/ideas/. skill_block.__main__ (line 79) only hands off to a door's own main when the door module sets COMPOSING_DOOR; skills/idea/door.py declares no such flag, so the generic fire path runs and the composing half — the commons write the door's docstring calls 'captured nothing' without — is skipped, silently, exit 0. Running skills/idea/door.py directly writes the record. Fix shape: COMPOSING_DOOR = True in skills/idea/door.py, and a proof that fires through skill_block and asserts the commons file exists — the flag is a one-liner, the proof is what stops it regressing. Check the other composing doors (sorted, saveslate) for the same flag while there.
